title: Hitting the wall ends the run with my result, and one action replays
description: Steering the snake into the wall ends the run with a game over message naming the final score, and the play-again action restarts at "Score 0" without reloading the page.

steps.goal: On the Snake game, start a run if one is not already running. Steer the snake into the wall and let the run end. Then start a fresh run using whatever the game offers to play again.
success: Steering into the wall ended the run with a game over message naming the final score
The ended run settled on its result with no hang and no error
One obvious action, such as a Play again control, started a fresh run with the score reading exactly Score 0 again, without reloading the page
